EmailTemplate.subject: We missed you at our “Empowering Travel Businesses: Understanding and Reducing Chargebacks with Flywire” webinar!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We missed you! Our “Empowering Travel Businesses: Understanding and Reducing Chargebacks with Flywire” webinar highlighted the intricacies of chargebacks and provided essential knowledge to reduce the risks.
Here is the link to the webinar recording <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-empowering-travel-businesses-understanding-and-reducing-chargebacks-with-flywire-2]]>.
Have questions? If you are a Flywire client, please reach out to your Relationship Manager. If not, just reply to this email and we’ll connect you with someone who can help.
Have a great day! Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
